Zero extension from a truncated i32 accumulator clears stale upper RAX bits through the existing typed cast transaction.
The unchanged pinned upstream Fibonacci program still executes all six assertions in ReleaseFast and ReleaseSmall, matching LLVM exit status, stdout and stderr.
